spec.claim_summary: Buying daily only when price is more than 5% below the most recent high underperforms plain daily dollar-cost averaging.
spec.untestable_reason: The rule is a DCA accumulation schedule with cash-holding and overlapping buys, not a repeatable single entry-exit rule expressible in the schema.
assumptions: NOT EXPRESSIBLE: DCA accumulation / cash-holding schedule ($1 per day saved and deployed only on >5% dips) requires overlapping positions, position sizing and cash management, which the single-position one-at-a-time engine cannot express.
Most Recent High Price period is undefined; closest core would need a highest_high lookback but no value can be recovered without inventing the rule.
No exit, stop, or holding rule is stated; dip-buying is an accumulation comparison, not an entry-exit system.
